integrity: Proof includes an explicit four-step labeled-agent witness; the standalone exact arithmetic program tests every bounded-size graph, color composition, rational comparison cell, and directed profile transition. Independent external validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Positive classification is restricted to connected complete bipartite graphs of order at most six and two-color source-symmetric single-peaked jump preferences. The proof of the parameter-universal claim uses exact rational comparison partitions and exhaustive finite-state graph cycle detection. No priority guarantee beyond inspected literature.
title: A sharp six-vertex finite-improvement boundary for single-peaked jump Schelling games
